findings.finding: The H1 period the 15 October report covers was pre-released on 29 September: total output EUR 184.0m (-4.7%), EBIT EUR 0.8m (0.6% margin), liquidity EUR 29.3m, and per First Berlin an H1 operating cash flow of almost EUR 40m. The headline lines of the report are therefore known.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the 29 Sep pre-release (weak H1 alongside 2027/2028 guide raises) the stock rose 8.56% to 60.90, then gave it all back by 13 Oct (55.35). On the 30 Jul Q2 order release it rose 7.85%. The name moves 3-9% on days with no news (e.g. -5.4% on 10 Sep 'ohne Ausloeser').
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The pre-release has been out for 12 sessions and the stock has already round-tripped its +8.6% reaction. Filed at 0 because the report's headline lines restate it.
findings.independence: First Berlin, 30 Sep 2026, restates the same figures plus the OCF: 'Wie erwartet lagen Umsatz, Gesamtleistung und EBIT in H1 unter Vorjahresniveau. Dafuer betrug der operative Cashflow fast EUR 40 Mio.' https://www.eqs-news.com/news/research/original-research-2g-energy-ag-von-first-berlin-equity-research-gmbh-buy/ae57e8dc-8542-4a40-9214-6b36b2df41d6_de

findings.finding: The FY26 guide (EUR 490m revenue, 9.5-10.5% EBIT margin) was reiterated on 29 Sep and at the 1 Oct CMD, but against H1 EBIT of EUR 0.8m it requires roughly EUR 47-51m of H2 EBIT on about EUR 300m+ of H2 revenue. The half-year report's forecast section is the one place it could soften. With no evidence it will, any change is a downside skew.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 28 Oct 2025 ad-hoc Prognoseanpassung (FY25 revenue and EBIT margin cut) is the last guide change. The 26 May 2026 ad-hoc order plus guide confirmation at the upper end moved +21.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The steep H2 has been visible since 29 Sep. finanztrends (2 Oct) calls the 0.6% margin 'aussergewoehnlich schwach' and says the full report will show how far off the target the company is, and the stock is down about 10% from 6 Oct to 13 Oct with no news, which is what a market doubting the H2 would look like. A reiteration is therefore not news, and only a change would move it. The company reiterated two weeks ago, so a change is unlikely.
findings.independence: Parmantier (25 Sep) expected 'Very weak first half ... EBIT around break-even' and a capital increase; finanztrends 2 Oct preview: 'Erst diese detaillierten Zwischenzahlen werden offenlegen' https://www.finanztrends.de/news/2g-energy-aktie-halbjahresbericht-am-15-oktober-entscheidend/

findings.finding: The most-circulated bear argument (Parmantier, Sell EUR 39) is that the only disclosed payment on the 275 MW Energy Vault order is USD 17.0m of reservation fees and that 2G has published no advance terms. 2G's own 29 Sep release says the data-center customer made a 'substantial down payment in the mid-double-digit millions', and the full half-year report's notes and subsequent-events section are where that can be itemised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a down-payment disclosure moving the stock in isolation. The Energy Vault order itself moved +9.49% on 23 Sep and was fully reversed within three sessions (-4.75%, -6.12%, -3.77%), while the Parmantier note went out 25 Sep 14:00.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: 2G's 'mid-double-digit millions' statement is public since 29 Sep. Itemised advance payments in the report could settle the dispute, but the 30 June balance sheet predates the September order, so the confirmation may not be there at all. Sized near 0.
findings.independence: 2G 29 Sep release: 'the customer also made a corresponding, substantial down payment in the mid-double-digit millions' https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/2g-energy-ag-again-secures-orders-exceeding-eur-400-million-in-the-third-quarter/557d43d1-6f45-4745-85e4-0db16fa4deef_en ; First Berlin OCF of almost EUR 40m in H1.
